title: Unify change-risk signal gathering into tools::change_signals
description: Extract gather(db, changed_paths, churn) -> ChangeSignals from the triplicated implementations in diff_impact.rs, pr_risk.rs, and review.rs (gather_change_stats, gather_affected, behavioral_coupling, build_recommended_reads). ChangeSignals carries per_file, total_blast, max_cognitive, affected_files, affected_symbols. diff_impact becomes a threshold-verdict view (~30 lines), pr_risk a weighted-composite view (~60), review a consumer. Fold tools/scoring.rs constants (BLAST_NORM etc.) into the module.
execution_record: Created tools::change_signals module with ChangeSignals struct and gather(db, changed_paths, churn) function. Moved BLAST_NORM/COMPLEXITY_NORM/CHURN_NORM/CHURN_WINDOW_DAYS and ChurnMap from scoring.rs. Rewrote diff_impact as thin verdict view (~100 lines, -20 net), pr_risk::compute as thin weighted-composite view (net -1 line), and review::compute to use ChangeSignals (net -77 lines). Deleted ChangeStats, gather_change_stats, gather_affected from review.rs. scoring.rs retains general-purpose utilities (normalize, round3, weighted_score, Signal). All 808 tests pass, clippy clean.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial, against 2427929):

Verdict: needs-attention

1. [high] gather() always computes affected files+symbols, but pr_risk never uses them and diff_impact only needs file paths. New unbounded work on callers that didn't pay for it before.

2. [medium] diff_impact lost the "complexity data unavailable" sentinel — old code checked Option<i64> max_cognitive, new code checks f.indexed which is a different predicate. Indexed files with null cognitive silently report max_cognitive=0.
